Replaced the placeholder ICD M79.A21 with R22.41 (right lower limb mass) as primary, plus M79.671 (right foot pain), L81.4 (skin hyperpigmentation), and Z80.8 (family hx malignancy). Hypothyroidism and HTN moved to supporting_conditions per Rule O. 99214 retained as moderate MDM E/M (new problem, uncertain prognosis, MRI ordered). No procedures or imaging performed today; MRI is ordered for workup. SNOMED list cleaned of two miscoded findings.
